xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheCompany: Canara HSBC Life Insurance Company Limited
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NoteForNonApplicabilityOfTheDi: The company has no Loans and Debt Securities, therefore, this disclosure is not required.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. Net Premium Income is Net of Reinsurance

2. Income from Investments (Net) - Policyholders' is Net of Amortization and losses (including capital gains). For the quarter ended 31st Dec 2025 and nine months ended 31st Dec 2025, it is higher than quarter ended 30th Sep 2025 and nine months ended 31st Dec 2024, respectively, on account of higher returns from equity markets.

3. Transfer of funds from Shareholders' A/c and Transfer of funds to Policyholders' A/c Includes contribution of funds from shareholders accounts towards excess EOM and remuneration of MD/CEOs/WTD/Other KMPs

4. Benefits Paid (Net) is Inclusive of interim and other bonuses and net of reinsurance

5. Expenses other than those related to insurance business is Inclusive of Corporate Social Responsibility expenditure and Penalties (if any)

6. Dividend per share is Interim and Final dividend recommended for respective financial year

7. Advertisement and publicity expenses have been included in other operating expenses for the the current period.

8. Interim Bonus includes Terminal Bonus.

9. Profit carried to Balance Sheet Represents Accumulated Profit

10. Analytical ratios have been calculated as per definition given in IRDAI Analytical ratios disclosure

11. Profit/Loss on Derivative amount (TRAD & AnnuityR Fund) is being considered as "Unrealised Gain/Loss" and is included while computing the "Yield with Unrealised Gain and realised"

12. NPA: Company has provided 100% provision on CPs and NCDs of IL&FS and IL&FS financial services Ltd, due to default in repayment obligations due to downgrade of rating to Default (D) category. Hence, Net NPA amount would become zero.

13. Persistency ratio (Regular Premium/ Limited Premium Payment under Individual Category):

13.1 Persistency ratios are calculated in accordance with the IRDAI circular no. IRDAI/F&A/CIR/MISC/256/09/2021 dated September 30, 2021 and are with a lag of one month. Persistency ratios include individual business only, Group business policies have been excluded from the persistency calculation.

13.2 Persistency ratios for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 have been calculated on December 31, 2025 for the policies issued in September to November period of the relevant years. For example, the 13th month persistency for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 is calculated for policies issued from September 1, 2024 to November 30, 2024.

13.3 Persistency ratios for the year ended December 31, 2025 have been calculated on December 31, 2025 for the policies issued in December to November period of the relevant years. For example, the 13th month persistency for the year ended December 31, 2025 is calculated for policies issued from December 1, 2023 to November 30, 2024.
